name: Alpine
description: Bright and clean with a delicate body. Alpine is our lightest roast — a gentle morning cup that lets the natural character of the bean shine through. Subtle floral notes and a soft, tea-like finish.

name: Field of Dreams
description: Our most approachable roast. Balanced and smooth with notes of milk chocolate and a hint of dried fruit. Field of Dreams is the one that keeps you coming back — the kind of cup that makes you slow down and stay a little longer.

name: Big Tree
description: Bold and grounding, like standing at the base of something old and enormous. Big Tree is a full-bodied dark roast with a deep, roasty core, low acidity, and a long finish. For the mornings when you need to feel anchored.

name: Deep Sea
description: From the volcanic highlands of Sumatra, this extra dark roast goes all the way down. Earthy and intense with low acidity, a velvety body, and flavours of dark chocolate and cedar. A cup for the deep dives.

name: Estuary
description: Where things slow down and settle in. Estuary is our decaf blend — medium-dark, smooth, and satisfying without the caffeine. Rich and rounded with notes of brown sugar and a clean, easy finish. The evening cup.
